title: Upgrade Compatibility — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Upgrade Compatibility solution should meet the objective: Test a two-version upgrade path in a local proxy setup, including storage layout, initialization, authorization, and a documented rollback/emergency plan. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
